rollback_contract.pointer_model: Use a dedicated active pointer such as /home/ubuntu/releases/openclaw-stage2-current that resolves to a retained immutable release directory.
preconditions: Current pointer resolves to the manifest recorded at activation time.
Previous release manifest exists, is hash-verified and is retained.
Target release is compatible with the external state/database schema or an approved restore path exists.
Rollback owner and maintenance authorization are active.
rollback_contract.command_model: A parameterized rollback command resolves the expected previous release, performs an atomic pointer swap under CAS, restarts the service through the authorized user systemd path, and runs the same manifest/PID/cwd/health/ready/Nginx readback matrix.
rollback_contract.failure_behavior: If the expected-current manifest changed, abort without mutation. If switch already happened and post-switch readback or observation fails, swap back to the verified previous pointer and re-run readback. Never delete the failed or previous release as part of rollback.
rollback_contract.state_boundary: Pointer rollback does not undo database or external Feishu side effects. State migration and external write compatibility must be proven separately; otherwise rollback is blocked or requires an approved restore procedure.
rollback_contract.evidence: Record candidate manifest, previous manifest, CAS precondition, switch result, rollback result, status-only probes and redacted acceptance receipts without secrets.
